subject: Staggered renewals — proposal to harmonize GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian dates
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: sophie.mitchell@atlassian.com, renewals@jetbrains.com, github-enterprise-sales@github.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Staggered renewals — proposal to harmonize GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian dates

Team / vendors,

Quick summary: our developer tooling renewals are spread across Q2 and Q3 this year (GHE in June, JetBrains in August, Atlassian in September). That distribution increases procurement overhead, causes billing churn and complicates budget forecasting.

Proposal: harmonize the three contracts to a single renewal date (target: 2027-12-31) using pro-rata adjustments so we don't lose coverage. We're open to: 12-month alignment or 24-month multi-year with a fixed discount tier. Please share high-level pricing for both a 12- and 24-month alignment option, any consolidation discounts for committing across products, and a quick note on how pro-rata/prorate would be handled.

I've attached a current_license_summary.csv (counts by team, license types, renewal dates). We're aiming for a recommendation to present to Finance and Legal by March 15.

Can each vendor confirm if they can:
- provide a consolidated quote that supports a common renewal date,
- offer any cross-product or multi-product discount, and
- allow staged opt-outs for teams with special procurement (security enclaves).

Internal ask: Karthik, Marissa — can you validate seat counts? Lauren — can you confirm budget window? Grace — I'll need a quick legal note on our standard SOW amendment process.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: current_license_summary.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Staggered renewals — proposal to harmonize GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian dates

Vivek —

Thanks for kicking this off. A few quick clarifying points:
- For GitHub Enterprise we currently have a mix of user-seat and org seat (GHES + Cloud). If vendors require multi-year commitments to unlock material discounts, we need to model headcount growth for 24 months.
- For JetBrains, some teams use floating licenses via a toolbox license server; changing to a different renewal cadence can be operationally heavy (we'll need an infra migration window).
- Marissa: can you pull last 6 months of actual usage from the tooling-metering dashboards and confirm teams with >80% utilization — those are harder to reduce.

If vendors provide both pro-rata and straight-to-next-term quotes, we can present a cost comparison. I'm attaching no file here — will sync with Marissa and send updated numbers by EOD Friday.

-Karthik
Director, Developer Productivity

From: Sophie Mitchell <sophie.mitchell@atlassian.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 15:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Staggered renewals — proposal to harmonize GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian dates

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the note and the CSV, Sophie here on Renewals for Atlassian. We can absolutely support a consolidated renewal date. High-level options: 

1) 12-month alignment (pro-rata) — we apply a pro-rata credit for the unused portion and invoice a new 12-month term to the alignment date. Typical timeline: quote in 3 business days + 7 business days to sign.
2) 24-month multi-year — 5-12% discount depending on seat tiers and whether Jira Software + Confluence + Jira Service Management are bundled. For your counts we see opportunity to tier-match at 7% for the combined bundle.

I've attached an initial Atlassian_quote_Mar2027.pdf with a pro-rata example and a line for a combined discount if you sign all three products to the same date. Questions: do you need separate legal SOWs per product, or would you prefer a single master subscription amendment?

We'll also need a point of contact for procurement to speed PO issuance.

Best,
Sophie Mitchell
Enterprise Renewals | Atlassian

Attachment: Atlassian_quote_Mar2027.pdf

On Mon, Mar 1, 2027 at 09:12 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team / vendors,
> 
> Quick summary: our developer tooling renewals are spread across Q2 and Q3 this year (GHE in June, JetBrains in August, Atlassian in September). That distribution increases procurement overhead, causes billing churn and complicates budget forecasting.
>

From: renewals@jetbrains.com <renewals@jetbrains.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 10:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Staggered renewals — proposal to harmonize GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian dates

Hi Vivek and team,

Elena from JetBrains Renewals here. Thanks for sharing your counts. A few notes from our side: 

- We can support aligning to a single renewal date. For floating licenses we will issue a pro-rata invoice for the shortened/lengthened period. We recommend targeting a calendar year-end renewal (Dec 31) to simplify annual budgeting.
- Discount structure: 3% under 250 seats, 8% for 250-499, 12% for 500+. Based on your CSV, it looks like you currently sit at ~420 active seats across teams — we can provide a rate card if you share team-level breakdown.
- Attachment: JetBrains_count_revision.xlsx with our suggested seat normalization (we collapsed some inactive accounts). Please review and confirm counts by March 11.

If you’re considering a 24-month commitment we can escalate to an enterprise-special pricing (and include early renewal credits).

Regards,
Elena Popov
Renewals Manager | JetBrains

Attachment: JetBrains_count_revision.xlsx

On Tue, Mar 2, 2027 at 11:05 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Vivek —
> 
> Thanks for kicking this off. A few quick clarifying points: ...

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 16:42:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Staggered renewals — proposal to harmonize GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian dates

Folks,

Summary of responses from vendors and next steps: 
- Atlassian: pro-rata alignment available; 7% combined-bundle discount indicated (see attached PDF).
- JetBrains: provided revised seat normalization and a tiered discount; asked for team-level confirmation by Mar 11.
- GitHub: awaiting formal quote from GH Enterprise Sales (I pinged them again; copying procurement).

Decisions / asks:
1) Approve proceeding with 12-month alignment to target 2027-12-31 unless Finance prefers a 24-month fixed discount. If we go 24 months, Karthik please model headcount growth assumptions.
2) Marissa: validate JetBrains counts in JetBrains_count_revision.xlsx and flag any floating-license teams that need a migration window (deadline: Mar 11).
3) Lauren: confirm that we can absorb the pro-rata cashflow in Q2/Q3 or if we need to request an exceptional budget profile from Finance.
4) Grace: prepare a short amendment template (one-page) that Legal can attach to each vendor’s quote — include language for pro-rata credits and staged opt-outs.

If everyone is aligned I will consolidate vendor quotes into a single mailing for Finance approval next week. Attaching a draft consolidation_MOA_draft.pdf that Legal can review.

Thanks — aiming to close vendor commitments by Mar 22.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: consolidation_MOA_draft.pdf
